observations.normal_flow_and_boundaries: Notion application-to-processor and stored-content confidentiality boundaries; Microsoft shared-gateway responsibility without invented routing topology.
observations.invariant: Both explicitly label their invariants as inferred design questions, not undocumented vendor guarantees.
observations.mechanism_and_feedback: Notion keeps unknown intrusion-to-dataset mapping; Microsoft retains latent defect, triggering load/capacity combination and survivor-load feedback.

observations.architectural_alternatives: Three per case, each tied to a validated numbered causal edge with mechanism, tradeoff and residual risk. Controls are explicitly proposed, not claims about vendor omissions.
